_documentation: rig.json -- PORTABLE rig config. Safe to copy between a PC and a Pi: it carries the physical rig's mechanics, geometry, motion feel and per-axis tuning, and never a machine-specific NIC/IP. Owned by the web UI on both platforms. 'global' = per-rig values shared across all axes; 'axes' = one entry per actuator -- the per-unit overlay for the golden-image / provisioning model (clone a shared template, then override per axis). Keys prefixed with '_' are documentation-only.
_section_global: Per-rig values shared across all axes: command conditioning + motion-blend feel, and fault-reset policy (safety policy travels with the rig). conditioningMode: bypass|interpolate|filter.
_section_axes: One object per axis. slaveIndex is the EtherCAT bus position (part of the rig's wiring). followingErrorWindowMm is PER-AXIS now (written to drive object 0x6065, counts = mm * countsPerMm). Future per-axis tuning -- inertia ratio (C00.06), notch freq/width/depth -- will live in each axis object too.
